lucee.notes: With Lucee 6.1, the underlying encoder was switched to Use Apache Common Codec, which is stricter but more standards compliant

name: URLEncode
description: Encodes a string to be URL-safe according to the application/x-www-form-urlencoded MIME format

params.name: charset
params.description:
The World Wide Web Consortium Recommendation states that UTF-8 should be used as per
    <https://www.w3.org/TR/html40/appendix/notes.html#non-ascii-chars>

- Using different charsets may cause incompatibilities with other systems.

params.name: force
params.description: If false, then the string will not be encoded if it does not contain unsafe characters.
